what: Destination-staging transfer for cpcb-aqi-exceedance: copy the five accepted cpcb-aqi-build-004 artifact files (artifact a749f0df2f9dd010, digests equal to the package MANIFEST.json) from private staging release 436180445 into the private dataset repository earino/cpcb-aqi-exceedance release 436366305 (v2026.11), under the flat asset names the download helper restores. Each asset is verified against its recorded sha256 on arrival and against the server's own digest after upload; peak worker disk is one asset (88.8 MB total), so the bytes never pass through the coordinator. Asset ids were resolved by digest match through publish-dataset.py --stream-test, not hand-copied.
